tasks.title: D5-02a exact mirror correctness boundary
tasks.request: Using only the attached documents, explain the exact-body duplicate suppression rule, why two byte-identical mirror sources must not count as independent corroboration, and which fail-closed conditions prevent a truncated or skipped source from suppressing later evidence. Preserve the distinction between source provenance and synthesis citation authority. Do not use web research or outside knowledge.

tasks.title: D5-02a measured promotion decision
tasks.request: Using only the attached documents, explain how WorkSpace should decide whether exact-body duplicate suppression may become a production default. Connect the duplicate-body rule to Verified Task Success, First-Pass Verified Success, verified task count, Evidence Coverage, required validators, token efficiency, benchmark lineage, and the rule that a verified NO-GO is a valid engineering outcome. Do not use web research or outside knowledge.
